g.text: Partition key skew: one shard is hot while the stream has room to spare
- shardId-000000000000 carries 67% of the bytes across 8 shards, 5.3x the average
- the average shard peaks at 18% of its write limit, below the 50% that would mean the stream is simply full
Most frequent partition keys sampled from shardId-000000000000
Sampled from the records in the shard now, which are not the records that were rejected earlier. Evidence
about which keys dominate, not proof of which one caused a throttle.
adding shards will not help: the same partition key still hashes to one shard. Instead, use a partition key
with more distinct values, or append a suffix to spread one busy key across shards and reassemble downstream
